Is that all you have to say, you enemies of God!
As promised, I will let you fight God. Come, then, to the 'Land of Origin'.
Madness! The light has not yet gone out. They must not be allowed to go!
Of course I have not given up on the coming of the 'New World'. // But I find I wish to test it: this truth they speak of. // [1]Besides, that one has earned the right.

strings.tl: Wh-what is... this...

No one will attack you. [1]No one will make a fool of you. // Everyone will accept you. Everyone will love you.

Y-you are...
We are you yourself... [1]your true form, held down all these years.
Because you fear being tormented by others, [1]you devote yourself to others... // Because you cannot believe in others, you show them a smile...

[HERO]-san!!

So that is how it was... [1][HERO]-san, had you heard about this?

Fatum-san [1]has gone up to the surface with Sadiya-san... But...
